_comment: Local test-bed config. Copy to tests/config/test-bed.json and fill in.
test-bed.json is gitignored. AGENTSHELL_TEST_BED_CONFIG overrides the path.
Never commit: db passwords, app passwords, salts, certificates, or absolute
personal paths (e.g. /home/<user>/). Keep this template fully redacted.
label: disposable-test-bed
_label_comment: Free-form label. Not used for safety; surfaced in reports.

db.name: REPLACE_DB_NAME
db._password: REPLACE — store in test-bed.json (gitignored), never here
db._port_comment: 0 means use the socket; non-zero means TCP, with the port value.

auth._admin_password: REPLACE — store in test-bed.json (gitignored), never here
auth._app_password: REPLACE — application password, stored in test-bed.json only

expect._comment: These are checked at bootstrap. Any mismatch refuses to run.
expect.server_uuid: REPLACE — MySQL @@server_uuid of the test instance
expect.expected_datadir: REPLACE — absolute path to test instance datadir
expect._grants_comment: Bootstrap checks the db user has NO grants beyond <name>.*
expect._baseline_comment: mysqldump produced at test-bed setup. The runner restores the test database from this snapshot under the exclusive runner lock; never used on the dev database.
